title: Sprint jump nerf
description: Nerfs sprint jumping by removing the boost you get
body:
# Sprint jump nerf

Removes the boost you get from sprint-jumping. I deleted a line of code that added a flat boost to the player if they're sprinting while jumping. Now enjoy running normally like a sane person !

From version 1.1 onwards you can still perform a traditional sprint jump once every 3 seconds, to make jumping gaps easier.
